rd.researchQuestion: Which part of the Visual Engineering SequentialReveal behavior can Forma present with CSS alone, and which part must remain runtime orchestration?
rd.technicalUncertainty: Whether position-derived CSS timing can produce row-major reveal with a duration cap, a static default, and a reduced-motion override while keeping content semantically available from time zero.
